target: Spoiler-free 100% completion of the finalized iOS Platinum route: all Story and Mercenary stages on every difficulty, every treasure and combination, the complete weapon and upgrade catalog, and all Coin Shooting targets

areas.name: Platinum Mobile Route
areas.location_cue: The iPhone or iPod touch title menu showing Story, Mercenary, and unlockable extra modes.
areas.note: Use the finalized mobile campaign rather than an older truncated build.

items.label: Use the Platinum iOS Content Set

levels.1: The finalized update contains the broadest mobile checklist.
levels.2: Run the iPhone/iPod touch Platinum version updated through January 2011.
levels.3: Verify Story lists twenty-two stage slots and Mercenary lists forty-four before creating progress. If either list ends early, the installed build is incomplete and must not be used as the primary route.

levels.1: Precise drag aiming matters in timed missions.
levels.2: Test movement, aim dragging, action prompts, inventory tabs, and reload motion.
levels.3: Confirm the virtual stick reaches every direction, the reticle tracks one-to-one, contextual buttons register once, and device tilt reloads without changing aim; disable rotation interruptions.

levels.1: Older mobile and microconsole builds do not add required content.
levels.2: Do not merge N-Gage or Zeebo progression into this Platinum save.
levels.3: The chosen-route catalog treats those releases as lower-fidelity alternatives with no verified exclusive checklist. Preserve them separately, but count only the finalized iOS/Platinum route here.

items.label: Back Up the Empty Progress File

levels.1: The retired application has no modern cloud guarantee.
levels.2: Copy the application save before clearing Story Stage 01.
levels.3: Close the app, preserve its complete documents and library data, reopen it, and confirm the empty Story, Mercenary, armory, and extra-mode records load before beginning.
